CustomField.description: What kind of agent this is. Communication (API value Chat): talks with a person over web chat, WhatsApp or the Home copilot, keeps the conversation and stops at every reply. Automation (API value Trigger): runs in one go from a Flow, Apex or a schedule on a record and a payload, works until the goal is met and returns a result. Both: the same agent does both. The API values are unchanged so existing automations keep working.
CustomField.label: Agent Type
